name: Structured
description: Structured combines all your tasks and to-dos into a single visual timeline.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Structured to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Structured to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.structured.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Structured MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structured provides these MCP tools: complete_task, create_recurring_task, create_task, delete_task, get_account, get_inbox, get_supported_symbols, get_tasks_for_day, get_today, list_tasks, and update_task.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Structured?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Structured in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Structured requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Structured is developed by unorderly GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
